en.text: Sandberg is a lake in Kutna Hora, offering a place of peace amidst nature.

en.name: Park pod Vlašským dvorem
en.text: The playground in the park below the Italian Court in Kutna Hora offers fun for children in a historical setting.

en.name: DH Vostrov
en.text: DH Vostrov in Kutna Hora is a popular playground for families with children.

en.name: Kutnohorská plovárna
en.text: This swimming facility in Kutna Hora offers water fun and relaxation for the whole family.

en.name: České muzeum stříbra
en.text: The Czech Silver Museum in Kutná Hora guides visitors through the city's rich history of silver mining. A highlight is the tour of a medieval mine gallery beneath the Hrádek castle.

en.name: GASK
en.text: The Gallery of the Central Bohemian Region is housed in an impressive former Jesuit College in Kutná Hora. It presents modern and contemporary art in spacious, historically significant premises.

en.name: Tylovo divadlo
en.text: The municipal Tyl Theatre in Kutná Hora is an important cultural center for drama and musical performances. The elegant building is named after the famous playwright Josef Kajetán Tyl, who was born in the city.

en.name: kostnice
en.text: The famous Sedlec Ossuary near Kutná Hora contains artistic decorations made from the bones of thousands of people. This unique monument is located beneath the Cemetery Church of All Saints.

en.name: Vlašský dvůr
en.text: The Italian Court was once the royal mint and residence of Bohemian kings in Kutná Hora. Visitors can now tour the royal chapel and exhibitions on the history of coin minting.

en.name: Kamenný dům
en.text: The Stone House in Kutná Hora is one of the most significant Late Gothic residential buildings in Bohemia. It houses exhibitions from the Silver Museum about burgher life and crafts in the Middle Ages.

en.name: Tylův dům
en.text: This museum is located in the birthplace of Josef Kajetán Tyl, the author of the Czech national anthem. The exhibition is dedicated to the life and work of this significant poet and playwright.

en.name: Katedrála Nanebevzetí Panny Marie a sv. Jana Křtitele
en.text: This majestic cathedral in Sedlec is part of the UNESCO World Heritage and was renovated in the Baroque Gothic style. It impresses with its monumental architecture and light-filled interiors.

en.name: Dačického dům
en.text: The Dačický House in Kutná Hora serves as an interactive center for the city's UNESCO World Heritage. It offers visitors exciting insights into the architecture and history of this historic building.

en.name: Cimburk
en.text: This archaeological site near Kutná Hora marks the remains of a medieval fortification. Visitors can explore the traces of earlier settlement in the picturesque surroundings.

en.name: Aliens vs. Predators
en.text: This unusual museum in Kutná Hora is dedicated to the famous creatures from the science-fiction film world. Fans can admire detailed models and film props from the popular series here.

en.name: Vodní scéna GASK
en.text: The water stage of the GASK gallery in Kutná Hora provides a unique backdrop for outdoor theatre and music events. The modern design blends harmoniously into the surroundings of the historic Jesuit College.

en.name: Menhiry v Kutné Hoře
en.text: This group of modern menhirs in Kutná Hora is designed as a spiritual site and geomantic monument. The stones form an interesting contrast to the city's historical backdrop.

en.name: Kaňk
en.text: Kaňk is a prominent hill near Kutná Hora with a lookout tower that offers a wide view over the region. The area is historically closely linked to silver mining.

en.name: Gothic Stone Fountain
en.text: This Late Gothic stone fountain is an architectural gem in the historic center of Kutná Hora. It once served as a public water reservoir and impresses with its delicate stonework.

en.name: Vorlíčkovy sady
en.text: Vorlíček Orchards is a well-maintained park in Kutná Hora that invites walking and relaxation. The park offers beautiful green spaces and tranquility away from the tourist paths.

en.name: hradiště Denemark
en.text: This viewpoint near Kutná Hora is located at the site of a former prehistoric fortified settlement. Visitors enjoy a lovely view of the Vrchlice stream and the surroundings from here.

en.name: Geologická expozice Čížkova skála
en.text: This geological open-air exhibition displays various types of rocks from the region around Kutná Hora. Information boards at the rock face explain earth history and local geology.

en.name: Mlýn Cimburk
en.text: The ruins of the Cimburk Mill are idyllically located by a stream near Kutná Hora. The historical remains are a popular destination for hikers wishing to explore the natural surroundings.

en.name: menhir
en.text: This prehistoric menhir near Kutná Hora stands as a lonely witness to past eras in the landscape. It is an interesting destination for visitors interested in archaeological monuments.

en.name: Galerie u Vlašského dvora
en.text: This gallery, located in the immediate vicinity of the Italian Court in Kutná Hora, displays contemporary art and crafts. The exhibitions provide a great complement to a visit to the historic mint.

en.name: Holy Trinity
en.text: The Holy Trinity Church is a significant Gothic house of worship in Kutná Hora, known for its architecture. The church is located slightly away from the center and offers an atmosphere of peace and reflection.

en.name: Nejsvětější srdce Páně
en.text: The Church of the Most Sacred Heart of Our Lord in Kutná Hora is a remarkable sacred building from the early 20th century. It serves as a place of prayer and is known for its religious significance in the community.

en.name: kostel Panny Marie Na Náměti
en.text: The Church of Our Lady on the Market in Kutná Hora is an important Gothic architectural monument with a rich history. It shapes the cityscape and houses significant religious artworks in its interior.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Kutná Hora ist eine der historisch bedeutendsten Städte der Tschechischen Republik und steht seit 1995 auf der Liste des UNESCO-Weltkulturerbes. Im Mittelalter war sie aufgrund ihrer reichen Silbervorkommen die zweitwichtigste Stadt im Königreich Böhmen nach Prag. Das architektonische Juwel der Stadt ist der Dom der Heiligen Barbara, ein Meisterwerk der Spätgotik, das den Schutzpatronen der Bergleute gewidmet ist. Ein weiteres markantes Denkmal ist das Sedletz-Ossuarium, eine Kapelle, die mit den Knochen von über 40.000 Menschen künstlerisch dekoriert ist. Der Welsche Hof (Vlašský dvůr) diente einst als königliche Münzstätte und Residenz, wo der Prager Groschen geprägt wurde. Das historische Zentrum mit seinen engen Gassen, dem Steinernen Haus und dem mittelalterlichen Brunnen versetzt Besucher direkt in die Zeit des Silberbooms zurück. Heute ist Kutná Hora ein bedeutendes touristisches und kulturelles Zentrum, das durch Festivals und die Erhaltung seiner einzigartigen Bergbautraditionen lebendig bleibt.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Kutná Hora Csehország egyik történelmileg legjelentősebb városa, amely 1995 óta az UNESCO Világörökség része. A középkorban gazdag ezüstlelőhelyeinek köszönhetően a Cseh Királyság második legfontosabb városa volt Prága után. A város építészeti gyöngyszeme a Szent Borbála-templom, a késő gótika mesterműve, amelyet a bányászok védőszentjének szenteltek. Egy másik különleges látnivaló a Sedleci Osszárium (Csontkápolna), amelyet több mint 40 000 ember csontvázával díszítettek művészien. Az Olasz udvar (Vlašský dvůr) egykor királyi pénzverdének és rezidenciának adott otthont, itt verték a híres prágai garast. A történelmi városközpont szűk utcáival, a Kőházzal és a középkori kúttal hűen idézi fel az ezüstláz korszakát. Ma Kutná Hora jelentős turisztikai és kulturális központ, amely fesztiválokkal és egyedülálló bányászati hagyományainak ápolásával várja a látogatókat.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Kutná Hora este unul dintre cele mai importante orașe istorice din Republica Cehă, fiind inclus pe lista Patrimoniului Mondial UNESCO din 1995. În Evul Mediu, datorită zăcămintelor bogate de argint, a fost al doilea cel mai important oraș din Regatul Boemiei după Praga. Bijuteria arhitecturală a orașului este Catedrala Sfânta Barbara, o capodoperă a stilului gotic târziu, dedicată patroanei minerilor. Un alt monument remarcabil este Osuarul din Sedlec, o capelă decorată artistic cu oasele a peste 40.000 de oameni. Curtea Italiană (Vlašský dvůr) a servit odinioară drept monetărie regală și reședință, unde a fost bătut groșul de Praga. Centrul istoric, cu străzile sale înguste, Casa de Piatră și fântâna medievală, transportă vizitatorii direct în epoca boom-ului argintului. Astăzi, Kutná Hora este un centru turistic și cultural major, menținut viu prin festivaluri și conservarea tradițiilor sale miniere unice.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Kutná Hora is one of the most historically significant cities in the Czech Republic, inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage list since 1995. During the Middle Ages, it was the second most important city in the Kingdom of Bohemia after Prague, thanks to its vast silver deposits. The architectural jewel of the city is the Cathedral of St. Barbara, a masterpiece of Late Gothic design dedicated to the patron saint of miners. Another distinctive monument is the Sedlec Ossuary, a chapel artistically decorated with the bones of over 40,000 people. The Italian Court (Vlašský dvůr) once served as the royal mint and residence, where the Prague groschen was struck. The historic center, with its narrow streets, the Stone House, and the medieval stone fountain, preserves the atmosphere of the silver boom era. Today, Kutná Hora is a major tourist and cultural hub, hosting numerous festivals and maintaining its unique mining heritage.
descriptionAdvanced.es: Kutná Hora, el 'tesoro del reino de Bohemia', debe su riqueza a la minería de plata medieval. La ciudad compitió antaño económica y culturalmente con Praga. Su extraordinaria riqueza permitió construir edificios magníficos que le valieron el estatus de Patrimonio de la Humanidad por la UNESCO en 1995. El emblema es la monumental catedral gótica de Santa Bárbara, dedicada a los mineros. Otra joya es la Corte Italiana (Vlašský dvůr), antigua casa de la moneda real donde se acuñaba el famoso groschen de Praga. También es mundialmente famoso el osario de Sedlec, una capilla decorada con los huesos de decenas de miles de personas, lo que supone una atracción macabra pero fascinante.
descriptionAdvanced.pt: Kutná Hora, o 'tesouro do reino da Boêmia', deve a sua riqueza à mineração de prata na Idade Média. A cidade competiu outrora económica e culturalmente com Praga. A sua extraordinária riqueza levou à construção de edifícios magníficos, que garantiram à cidade o estatuto de Património Mundial da UNESCO em 1995. O ex-líbris é a monumental catedral gótica de Santa Bárbara, dedicada aos mineiros. Outra jóia é a Corte Italiana (Vlašský dvůr), a antiga casa da moeda real, onde foi cunhado o famoso groschen de Praga. Mundialmente famoso é também o Ossário de Sedlec, uma capela decorada com os ossos de dezenas de milhares de pessoas, o que constitui uma visão macabra mas fascinante.
descriptionAdvanced.fr: Kutná Hora, le 'trésor du royaume de Bohême', doit sa richesse à l'exploitation des mines d'argent au Moyen Âge. La ville rivalisait autrefois sur les plans économique et culturel avec Prague. Son extraordinaire richesse a permis l'édification de bâtiments magnifiques qui ont valu à la ville d'être classée au patrimoine mondial de l'UNESCO en 1995. Son emblème est la monumentale cathédrale gothique Sainte-Barbe, dédiée aux mineurs. Un autre joyau est la Cour italienne (Vlašský dvůr), l'ancien hôtel de la monnaie royale où était frappé le célèbre gros de Prague. L'ossuaire de Sedlec, une chapelle décorée avec les ossements de dizaines de milliers de personnes, est également mondialement connu et constitue une curiosité macabre mais fascinante.

de: Kutná Hora wurde 1995 zum UNESCO-Weltkulturerbe erklärt.
Der Bau des Barbaradoms begann im Jahr 1388.
Die Silberminen erreichten im 14. Jahrhundert ihren Höhepunkt.
Im Sedletz-Ossuarium befinden sich Reste von ca. 40.000 Menschen.
Der Prager Groschen wurde hier ab 1300 geprägt.
Die Stadt hat heute etwa 21.000 Einwohner.
hu: 1995-ben került fel az UNESCO Világörökségi listájára.
A városban verték a prágai garast 1300-tól kezdve.
Kutná Hora a 14. században Európa egyik leggazdagabb városa volt.
ro: Kutná Hora este sit UNESCO din anul 1995.
Catedrala Sfânta Barbara a fost începută în 1388.
Osuarul din Sedlec conține oasele a peste 40.000 de persoane.
Monetăria regală a bătut groșul de Praga din anul 1300.
Orașul a furnizat o treime din producția europeană de argint.
Populația actuală este de aproximativ 21.000 de locuitori.
en: Inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage site in 1995.
Construction of St. Barbara's Cathedral started in 1388.
The town provided one-third of Europe's silver in the 14th century.
The Sedlec Ossuary was decorated in its current form in 1870.
The Royal Mint was established here by King Wenceslaus II.
The city features a medieval mining museum (Hrádek).
es: El centro histórico de la ciudad fue declarado Patrimonio de la Humanidad por la UNESCO en 1995.
La construcción de la catedral de Santa Bárbara comenzó en 1388.
El groschen de Praga se acuñó en Kutná Hora desde 1300 hasta 1547.
El osario de Sedlec contiene los restos de entre 40.000 y 70.000 personas.
En el siglo XIV, Kutná Hora era la segunda ciudad más grande de Bohemia tras Praga.
El Hrádek, un pequeño castillo, alberga hoy el Museo Checo de la Plata.
La fuente de piedra del siglo XV es una obra maestra de la cantería gótica tardía.
La ciudad sufrió un declive tras el agotamiento de las minas de plata en el siglo XVI.
pt: O centro histórico da cidade foi declarado Património Mundial da UNESCO em 1995.
A construção da catedral de Santa Bárbara começou em 1388.
O groschen de Praga foi cunhado em Kutná Hora de 1300 a 1547.
O Ossário de Sedlec contém os restos mortais de cerca de 40.000 a 70.000 pessoas.
No século XIV, Kutná Hora era a segunda maior cidade da Boêmia, depois de Praga.
O Hrádek, um pequeno castelo, abriga hoje o Museu Checo da Prata.
A fonte de pedra do século XV é uma obra-prima da cantaria do gótico tardio.
A cidade sofreu um declínio após o esgotamento das minas de prata no século XVI.
fr: Le centre historique de la ville a été classé au patrimoine mondial de l'UNESCO en 1995.
La construction de la cathédrale Sainte-Barbe a débuté en 1388.
Le gros de Prague a été frappé à Kutná Hora de 1300 à 1547.
L'ossuaire de Sedlec contient les restes d'environ 40 000 à 70 000 personnes.
Au XIVe siècle, Kutná Hora était la deuxième plus grande ville de Bohême après Prague.
Le Hrádek, un petit château, abrite aujourd'hui le musée tchèque de l'argent.
La fontaine de pierre du XVe siècle est un chef-d'œuvre de la taille de pierre de style gothique tardif.
La ville a connu un déclin après l'épuisement des mines d'argent au XVIe siècle.
